root_cause: powerhouse-composio-linkedin-setup could only create organization-scoped links; a personal member connection that failed its healthcheck had no way to be re-authorized, and the earlier company link was created for a test user id.
fix: New action create_personal_link: personal member scopes only, bound to the canonical owner id, returns a redirect link. Company link path unchanged.
prevention_rule: Every connection a daily process depends on must have a documented re-authorization action that uses its own scopes and owner.
terminal_rule: After merge and deploy, create_personal_link returns a redirect_url and, after approval, status reports personal_ready true.
